narrative_nodes.speaker: narrator
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 护士站里，弘子正和一名年轻护士核对交接记录。那名护士一边听，一边把患者提出的问题认真记在旁边。
narrative_nodes.en: At the nurses’ station, Hiroko is reviewing handover records with a young nurse. The nurse listens carefully and writes down a patient’s questions in the margin.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 杉村弘子
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 坂口医生，正好。给您介绍一下，薗田愛実。她以前在护理学校就是我的后辈。
narrative_nodes.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, perfect timing. Let me introduce Itsumi Sonoda. She was my junior at nursing school.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 薗田愛実
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 初次见面！我是薗田愛実，主要在外科和病房做护理。以后请多关照！
narrative_nodes.en: Nice to meet you! I am Itsumi Sonoda. I mostly work with surgical patients and on the ward. I look forward to working with you!

narrative_nodes.speaker: 坂口隆司
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 请多关照。听起来你和弘子很熟悉。
narrative_nodes.en: Likewise. Sounds like you and Hiroko know each other well.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 薗田愛実
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 嗯！在学校时就很佩服弘子前辈。可不是因为前辈在这里，我才想好好工作的哦。
narrative_nodes.en: Yes! I admired Hiroko even at school. But that does not mean I only want to work hard because she is here!

narrative_nodes.speaker: 杉村弘子
narrative_nodes.en: I never said you were going to slack off.

narrative_nodes.speaker: narrator
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 愛実看了一眼手中的交接单，把其中一张翻到正面。
narrative_nodes.en: Itsumi glances at her handover form and turns one sheet face up.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 薗田愛実
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 我先去看看那位住院患者。她不是有什么急事，只是有几个问题想当面问清楚。
narrative_nodes.en: I should go and see a patient on the ward. It is not urgent, but she has a few questions she wants to ask in person.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 坂口隆司
narrative_nodes.en: Have you already spoken with her?

narrative_nodes.speaker: 薗田愛実
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 问过啦。不过她刚才还没想好怎么说，我答应一会儿再去。
narrative_nodes.en: I did! She was not quite ready to put it into words, so I said I would come back.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 杉村弘子
narrative_nodes.en: Go ahead. Finish the handover when you return.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 薗田愛実
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 明白！坂口医生，下次我再慢慢向您介绍病房的情况！
narrative_nodes.en: Got it! Doctor Sakaguchi, next time I will tell you more about the ward!

narrative_nodes.speaker: narrator
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 愛実笑着向两人挥手，快步走向病房。她离开以后，弘子才重新拿起交接表。
narrative_nodes.en: Itsumi waves cheerfully and heads toward the ward. After she leaves, Hiroko picks up the handover form again.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 杉村弘子
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 她做事很有精神。不过病人的事，她倒是肯放慢脚步听人说完。
narrative_nodes.en: She is energetic. But when it comes to patients, she knows how to slow down and listen.

narrative_nodes.speaker: 坂口隆司
narrative_nodes.zh_CN: 看得出来。是个很愿意和患者打交道的护士。
narrative_nodes.en: I can see that. She seems to enjoy caring for patients.
